summary: The internet is a utility and public service institutions should not be burdened with internet infrastructure costs. Sunsetting the E-Rate program would increase costs on local governments and reduce services.

claims.argument: Sunsetting the program would increase costs on local taxing authorities and reduce services.
claims.evidence_quote: If you sunset the program, costs don't go away and will ultimately fall on local taxing authorities, who will increase taxes, drastically cut service access, or eliminate access.
